extracted.name: Pasta in Bechamel
extracted.description: Kids just like us wants a change. The kids said they were tired of Mac and cheese. Here is an alternative.
ingredient_lines: As needed water to boil pasta
As needed salt for boiling pasta
As needed oil for boiling pasta
instruction_lines: Dice the bacon and onion. Heat the butter and fry the onion and bacon. Boil the pasta and drain. Add the drained pasta to the onions.
Stir together and set aside. Melt the butter and add the flour with spice.
Fry the flour in the butter making a paste. Whisk the milk and roux.
When the Bechamel sauce is done pour into the pasta. Stir into the pasta and mix well. Serve I hope you enjoy!!!
